description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates how to show the input method subtype enabler, either for all input methods or specific ones with multiple subtypes, by launching the appropriate settings screen.

classes.name: ShowInputMethodAndSubtypeEnabler
classes.description: An Android Activity that provides UI buttons to show input method subtype settings for all IMEs or specific IMEs with multiple subtypes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI with buttons to trigger input method subtype enabler screens.

methods.name: showInputMethodAndSubtypeEnabler
methods.description: Launches the input method subtype settings screen, optionally for a specific input method ID.

methods.name: getEnabledInputMethodsThatHaveMultipleSubtypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of enabled input methods that have more than one subtype.
